name: PixiTween Director S12f: the crew finishes the film (text lane, protected requests, fix cap, finish gate, auto-finish)
description: Fixes the five causes found in the MG-2 event log: the showrunner removed the director's sunset scene twice, a queued build for a removed scene failed, slide-in headlines kept failing the safe-area rule, the style bible font was free text, and the finish gate could never pass while critiques waited 90 s for a browser. Adds a deterministic text lane (type and safe area) after every builder job, the film outline in builder prompts, protected user scenes, a fix cap, a finish gate that accepts capped findings, a done nudge with auto-finish, and honest metrics.

Edit scripts/live/s12-crew.ts: report Showrunner turns (crew.agent lane showrunner state thinking), Model turns (all agents) (agent.turn count), Fix jobs, Accepted findings (from the finish note, 0 if none), Failed jobs, Time to ready (first event to film.status ready, '-' if never) and Ended by ('finish', 'auto-finish' or 'idle'). Update scripts/live/s12-crew.test.ts.

Create fixtures/s12f/mg2-final.comp.json from the MG-2 film's last version (the owner places the source at debug/s12f/mg2/versions/ and events.jsonl beside it; if it is missing, set notes to 'blocked: owner copies data/films/film_cc0b50958184 to debug/s12f/mg2' and build a synthetic composition with three slide-in headlines whose entrance starts off-frame instead). Replace asset URLs with fixture ids; no data: URL longer than 200 characters.

Create fixtures/s12f/mg2-events.jsonl with only the storyboard.revised, job.update, review.finding, showrunner.heard and showrunner.say events, and fixtures/s12f/README.md saying where they came from.
acceptanceCriteria: computeMetrics on fixtures/s12f/mg2-events.jsonl reports Showrunner turns 21 and Model turns larger than 21 (or, with the synthetic fallback, the counts the test builds)
Ended by is 'idle' for the MG-2 events and 'finish' for an event list ending in a successful finish
Neither fixture contains 'Authorization', an API key pattern or a data: URL over 200 characters (test)

userStories.title: Rule R2 judges text at rest
userStories.description: As a reviewer of the film, I want the safe-area rule to look only at where text comes to rest so that an entrance sliding in from the edge is not a violation.
steps: Read docs/hackathon/steps/step-12-crew-swarm/s12f-crew-finish.md section 3.4, server/review/rules-core.ts (the R2 block), server/review/geometry.ts and the R2 tests.

Edit server/review/rules-core.ts: for each text layer, compute its rest frames = samples at or after its last position, scale or opacity keyframe frame (all samples when it has none; its last visible sample when none qualify). R2 checks only rest frames and its evidence says 'at rest'.
Update the existing R2 tests for the new sampling and add a test with a headline that slides in from x = -400 and rests inside the safe area.
acceptanceCriteria: A headline whose entrance starts off-frame and rests inside the safe area yields no outside-safe-area finding
A headline resting 40 px past the right safe edge still yields an outside-safe-area error whose evidence contains 'at rest'
A static headline outside the safe area is still reported (unchanged behaviour)
`npm run typecheck` passes
`npm test` passes (offline, no network)
`npm run lint` passes

userStories.title: fitTextToSafeArea moves text into the safe area at rest
userStories.description: As a text lane, I want a pure function that fits every text layer's rest box inside the safe area so that safe-area findings cannot happen after a build.
steps: Read docs/hackathon/steps/step-12-crew-swarm/s12f-crew-finish.md section 3.4, server/authoring/placement.ts, server/authoring/layers.ts and server/review/geometry.ts layerBoxAt.

Create server/crew/text-lane.ts exporting fitTextToSafeArea(comp, sceneId, { inset = 0.05, margin = 0.01 }) that returns { comp, moved }. Per text layer: rest box as in US-002; if wider than the safe rect set style.boxWidth to the safe width; if still taller reduce style.size in 5 % steps down to 70 % of the role default (textSize); then translate by the smallest move into the safe rect and shift every position keyframe by the same delta. Pure: the input is not mutated.
Create server/crew/text-lane.test.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: On fixtures/s12f/mg2-final.comp.json, running fitTextToSafeArea on every scene and then runRules gives 0 outside-safe-area findings
A text layer that already fits is returned unchanged and is absent from moved
For a slide-in headline moved by dx = 120, every position keyframe's x grows by exactly 120
A 120-character headline at 1080x1920 ends with boxWidth equal to the safe width and size not below 70 % of the default
`npm run typecheck` passes
`npm test` passes (offline, no network)
`npm run lint` passes

metadata.standingRule: Offline-only PRD. Every story is implementable and verifiable with unit tests, recorded fixtures and the browser preview; nothing here spends money or needs network. Live and paid checks are listed in metadata.manualGates and run by the owner.
guardrails: Work offline. Tests use recorded fixtures and DIRECTOR_REPLAY=1. Never call Meta, Clippy, Ollama or any other network service from a story, a test or a script you run during a story. The only network use allowed is `npm install`.
Never commit, push, tag, publish to npm, deploy or change repository settings. autoCommit is off and the owner commits.
For engine behaviour (composition JSON, Player, timeline, layer kinds) read docs/engine/README.md before writing code; never edit or copy engine source.

Never edit anything under node_modules/. The engine `reacthub-pixitweenjs` is a dependency: if it lacks something, add a row to ENGINE-NEEDS.md (what, where, proposed API, workaround, story) and use a workaround or set notes to 'blocked: engine'.
Edit only the files named in the story's steps, plus their tests. Files under shared/ are contracts (specs/hackathon/meta/06-contracts.md): change them only in a story that says so.
Never put keys, tokens, cookies or personal data in code, fixtures, logs or docs. Fixtures are redacted: no Authorization headers and no data: URLs longer than 200 characters.
No real brand names, logos or real people's likeness in prompts, fixtures or assets.
Record only real results. Never invent measurements, latencies, prices or test output.
Do not add a dependency that the story or 06-contracts.md does not name. If one is truly needed, say why in notes.
Debug output goes to debug/<step>/iteration-NN/ (gitignored). Only curated, redacted fixtures are committed, under fixtures/<step>/.

A step that would call a paid or live API is written as a script that prints an estimate and exits unless `--yes` is passed (`npm run live -- <step> --yes`, one file per step under scripts/live/). Create such scripts; never run them.
The text lane is deterministic code: never ask a model where text goes or which font it uses.
Do not raise maxTurns, the budget or any timeout to make the crew finish; the spec's causes are the fix.
R2 still reports text that rests outside the safe area; only motion through the edge stops counting.
Keep CREW_ENABLED=false behaviour unchanged apart from the R2 rest-frame change, and say in notes which S5a tests changed.

ui: Verify in the browser (dev-browser skill or preview): `npm run dev`, open the page named in the story, confirm the stated behaviour, and record what you saw in `notes`

manualGates: MG-2 re-run: owner runs `npm run live -- s12-crew --yes` (about $0.60). Pass: ready by finish or auto-finish within 4 min, cost at most $0.60, the sunset scene built and present, 0 failed jobs, at most 3 fix jobs on any scene, 4 builders at once at least once. Record the table in 09-crew-swarm.md.
